coverage.main: Read all seven pages of arXiv 2103.10013v1 (18 March 2021): Sections 1-6, Tables 1-6, Figure 1, references and Appendices A-D (datasets, training, query-size Table 7, architecture-mismatch Table 8). The NAACL 2021 anthology version was not retrieved separately.
coverage.supplement: Appendices A-D are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: Tables 2, 3 and 7 (extraction accuracy and cost) are model-extraction outcomes; MEA columns of Tables 5, 6 and 8 likewise.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.3; Table 4; Section 4.4 Table 5; Section 5 Table 6 AET columns; Appendix D Table 8
result_groups.population: Held-out data of TP-US, Yelp, AG news and Blog (sizes in Table 1; the attacked subset is not stated); adversarial typo examples crafted on the extracted BERT model (adv-bert) or black-box baselines, transferred to the victim BERT API, including mismatched architectures and softening/perturbation defenses
result_groups.outcome: transferability: 'the misclassification rate of adversarial samples on the victim APIs' / 'percentage of adversarial examples transferred from the extracted model to the victim model'
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct or extracted-model-success rule is stated; the two wordings of the metric do not fix the denominator.

f1.evidence: Victim accuracy on the held-out set is reported for every dataset, and defended-victim accuracy is given in parentheses in Table 6; extracted-model accuracies are also reported.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f3.evidence: No source-success restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates; the attacked subset and its size are not stated.

f5.evidence: Typo corruptions (insertion, deletion, swap, mistype, pronounce, replace-W) of gradient-selected tokens; no L-infinity/L2 radius applies to text. Reported in the non-image stratum.

f6.evidence: Code is linked (github.com/xlhex/extract_and_transfer); datasets are public, but victim/extracted checkpoints and the evaluated subset were not verified. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Repository linked in the paper; not listed, cloned or executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Victim clean accuracy is on the held-out set, but the attacked subset is not stated, so the populations cannot be matched.
